estimates.assumptions: 1 kg boneless skinless chicken thighs, raw weight; zero carbs/fiber
1 tbs ground coriander; standard 1 tbsp = ~6 g, ~3 g carbs mostly fiber
1 tbs ground cumin; standard 1 tbsp = ~6 g, ~3 g carbs with ~1 g fiber
1 tbs ground cardamom; standard 1 tbsp = ~7 g, ~4 g carbs with ~2 g fiber
1 tsp cayenne pepper; standard 1 tsp = ~2 g, ~1 g carbs mostly fiber
2 tsp paprika; standard 2 tsp = ~4 g, ~2 g carbs with ~1 g fiber
2 tbs lemon juice; standard 2 tbsp = ~30 ml, ~3 g carbs (sugars), negligible fiber
3 tbs olive oil; pure fat, zero carbs/fiber
1 cup (240 ml) plain Greek yogurt; standard non-fat/low-fat, ~8 g carbs (lactose), fiber negligible
1 garlic clove (~3 g); ~1 g carbs, negligible fiber
1 tsp ground cumin; standard 1 tsp = ~2 g, ~1 g carbs, negligible fiber
Splash of lemon juice (~1 tsp = 5 ml); ~0.5-1 g carbs, negligible fiber
Sliced lettuce for 6 servings (~150 g total); ~2 g carbs/100 g with most as fiber
Sliced tomato for 6 servings (~200 g total); ~4 g carbs/100 g with ~1 g fiber/100 g
6 standard pita breads (~60 g each, 25 g carbs + 3 g fiber per pita)
